info.title: com.clodhub/appointment-slots
info.description: The free start times of a day for a booking of a given length, from the day's opening windows and the busy blocks of the shop's calendars, with a buffer after each booking and a fixed step between starts; the instants a booking occupies, its re-check against busy blocks, and the range to ask calendars for. Takes the com.clodhub/opening-hours module as an argument for the wall-clock arithmetic.

methods.name: availableSlots
methods.description: The slots in which a booking fits each window, in order. Candidates start at the window's opening and follow every stepMinutes. Busy blocks are taken by start time: before a block, a candidate is offered when the booking plus the buffer ends by the block's start (and the booking ends by the window's close); a block then moves the next candidate to its end plus the buffer, off the step grid when that is where it ends. After the last block a candidate needs only to end by the close. Each window's opening and close are read in its own offset, so daylight saving days are right.

methods.name: eventInterval
methods.description: The instants a booking occupies: from its wall-clock start for its duration, widened by travelMinutes on both sides (the source's home visits: 30).

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Whether the interval meets a busy block: a block counts when it starts before the end and ends after the start, so touching edges do not overlap. Blocks missing a start or an end are not busy.

schema.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.
A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: busyWindow
methods.description: The range to ask a calendar for busy blocks on a date: from the first window's opening to the last window's close; null when there are no windows.

schema.description: A calendar date on the shop's wall clock, YYYY-MM-DD.
An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Madrid.

methods.name: settingsFrom
methods.description: Converts and checks settings given as numbers or as rendered template text; unset and unrendered values take the defaults (DEFAULT_SETTINGS).

methods.name: installedSettings
methods.description: The settings clod rendered at install, converted by settingsFrom.

open.description: A time on the shop's wall clock, HH:MM.

close.description: A time on the shop's wall clock, HH:MM.

Window.description: An opening window of the day, as com.clodhub/opening-hours gives it (windowsOn); close may be 24:00.

start.description: An instant as text, such as 2026-03-02T10:00:00Z.

Busy.description: A busy period as a calendar returns it (com.clodhub/calendar busy). A block missing a start or an end, or with an instant that cannot be read, is not busy.

start.description: A time on the shop's wall clock, HH:MM.

end.description: A time on the shop's wall clock, HH:MM.

Slot.description: A bookable start and the end of the booking on the wall clock. On the night the clocks go back, a time in the repeated hour may start two slots; it names the first.

OpeningHoursModule.description: The com.clodhub/opening-hours module (its web or server entry), passed in: these functions use its zonedInstant and wallTime.

date.description: A calendar date on the shop's wall clock, YYYY-MM-DD.

windows.description: The day's windows in order; none gives no slots.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Madrid.

durationMinutes.description: The whole booking, gaps between treatments included.

bufferMinutes.description: Free time a slot needs before the next busy block and that a busy block keeps after it; the bufferMinutes setting by default (10; the source used 30 for home visits).

stepMinutes.description: Minutes between candidate starts; the stepMinutes setting by default (30).

date.description: A calendar date on the shop's wall clock, YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: A time on the shop's wall clock, HH:MM.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Madrid.

travelMinutes.description: Travel time added before and after, for a visit away from the shop.

start.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

from.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

to.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

RawSettings.description: Settings as numbers or as the text clod renders into the settings template; a missing value, or one still in its {{name}} form, takes the default.

InvalidArgument.message: RangeError: a duration, buffer, step or travel time that is not a whole number in range, or a date, time or time zone outside its form (programmer error)

InvalidSettings.message: RangeError: stepMinutes is not a whole number from 5 to 240, or bufferMinutes from 0 to 240
